summary: EE-07 design section appended to src/design/engine.md without issues. All 6 required design elements are present. No existing sections modified. No Zig code written.

design_elements_verified.notes: New cancelled_branch_ids field added. Expected branch set derived from graph (no new field). Arrived branch set is implicit in state.tokens. Fired flag not required (DB-03 locking provides guarantee).

All 6 steps covered: (a) split vs join determination; (b) arrived-set via tokens_on_join; (c) expected_count = incoming_count - cancelled_count; (d) wait path; (e) fire path with PARALLEL_JOIN event; (f) all-cancelled path with INSTANCE_CANCELLED event and status=CANCELLED.
SELECT FOR UPDATE serialisation described with concrete 2-branch serialised arrival example. Post-fire safety explained. No explicit fired flag needed.
ParallelJoinPayload and InstanceCancelledPayload structs defined. JSON event schema for both fire and all-cancelled paths specified. Insertion contract (same DB transaction, DB-03) stated.
All 5 EE-07 acceptance criteria mapped to design elements in Section EE-07 §5.
OQ-4 explicitly resolved in §6. cancelled_branch_ids field design, initialisation, population by EE-08, usage by join handler, persistence, and flat-slice rationale all specified. OQ-4 marked closed.

open_questions_for_backend_dev.question: branch_id_with_index_0 selection for merged_branch_id: the design specifies using the branch with edge_index '0' from the split for determinism. For nested splits, this may not correctly identify the parent branch. BACKEND-DEV should verify the nested-split case and escalate if a more complex parent-branch tracking mechanism is needed.
open_questions_for_backend_dev.impact: Low — nested splits are an advanced topology; correctness of nested outer join tracking

open_questions_for_backend_dev.question: InstanceCancelledPayload.reason field value 'OPERATOR': EE-08 (operator-initiated cancellation) will also use an INSTANCE_CANCELLED event. EE-08 design should align its event payload with the InstanceCancelledPayload struct defined here to avoid a schema conflict.
open_questions_for_backend_dev.impact: Low — interface alignment between EE-07 and EE-08 event schemas
